cohort: 127 patients who underwent elective Cesarean section surgeries
finding: Obese patients (BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2) who underwent Cesarean sections were found to have a higher risk of developing wound infections compared to those with a BMI less than 30 kg/m2.
mod_finding: This study investigated wound infection incidence after cesarean section and did not compare different modes of delivery.
